Direct sequel to 1978 that ignores later sequels.

How Halloween (2018) connects

  • Topic: Halloween — Halloween (2018) is a direct sequel to 1978.
  • Character: Laurie Strode — The 2018 film recenters Laurie as a prepared survivor.
  • Character: Allyson Nelson — Allyson is pulled into Michael's 2018 return.
  • Work: Halloween Ends — The 2018 film leads into the trilogy that Ends closes.

What is Halloween (2018)?

The 2018 Halloween returns Laurie Strode as a fortified survivor confronting Michael forty years later, with Allyson in the next generation.

Key threads lead to Halloween, Laurie Strode, Allyson Nelson and Halloween Ends.
